name: US-led invasion begins
description: US and British airstrikes open Operation Enduring Freedom against the Taliban and al-Qaeda after the 9/11 attacks.

name: Fall of Mazar-i-Sharif
description: Northern Alliance forces, aided by US special forces and airpower, take the north's largest city.

name: Fall of Kabul
description: The Taliban abandon Kabul and Northern Alliance forces enter the capital.

name: Fall of Kandahar
description: The Taliban surrender their spiritual capital, ending their rule; Mullah Omar escapes.

name: Battle of Tora Bora
description: US-backed Afghan militias assault al-Qaeda's mountain caves, but Osama bin Laden escapes into Pakistan.

name: Operation Anaconda
description: US and allied troops attack Taliban and al-Qaeda fighters in the Shah-i-Kot Valley in the war's first big battle.

name: Operation Medusa
description: Canadian-led NATO troops drive Taliban fighters from Panjwayi near Kandahar as the insurgency grows.

name: Battle of Marjah
description: The surge's first major offensive retakes the Taliban stronghold of Marjah in Helmand province.

name: Killing of Osama bin Laden
description: US Navy SEALs kill the al-Qaeda leader in a raid on his compound in Abbottabad, Pakistan.

name: Kandahar massacre
description: A US soldier kills 16 villagers, most of them women and children, in two villages in Panjwayi district.

name: End of NATO combat mission
description: ISAF hands security to Afghan forces and gives way to a smaller NATO training mission.

name: Taliban capture Kunduz
description: The Taliban seize Kunduz, their first provincial capital since 2001, before Afghan forces retake it.

name: Kunduz hospital airstrike
description: A US gunship repeatedly strikes a Doctors Without Borders hospital, killing 42 patients and staff.

name: MOAB strike in Achin
description: The US drops its largest non-nuclear bomb on an Islamic State tunnel complex in Nangarhar province.

name: Kabul truck bombing
description: A truck bomb in Kabul's diplomatic quarter kills more than 90 people and wounds hundreds.

name: Doha Agreement
description: The US and the Taliban agree on a full US troop withdrawal in exchange for Taliban security guarantees.

name: Kabul maternity ward attack
description: Gunmen attack a maternity ward in Dasht-e-Barchi, killing 24, including mothers and newborns.

name: 2021 Taliban offensive
description: As US troops withdraw, the Taliban take rural districts, then provincial capitals in quick succession.

name: Taliban take Kabul
description: President Ghani flees and the Taliban enter Kabul, retaking power after 20 years.

name: Kabul airport bombing
description: An Islamic State suicide bombing at the airport's Abbey Gate kills about 170 Afghans and 13 US troops.
